_comment: A bounded 400x300m neighborhood (containing a real roundabout + ramp interchange) carved out of the REAL nuScenes singapore-onenorth city map -- not a Roboflow export. semantic_map.pkl is the full, uncropped real city map (its own H matrix already expects absolute nuScenes world coordinates); world_origin_x/y is what lets this map's own small simulator canvas publish coordinates in that SAME absolute frame instead of a local 0-based one, so both semantic_map.pkl's map-conditioning lookup and basemap.png's cropped display line up correctly. There is no roboflow_export/ for this map -- window1_tracker.py detects that and derives the pedestrian walkable area from semantic_map.pkl's own channel 0 instead (see build_walkable_area_from_semantic_map()). waypoints.json was derived from the real lane/lane_connector topology at this location (see map_tools/build_waypoints_from_nuscenes.py), not hand-authored.
